subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should maintainers still sponsor a cron timeline feature in the current Control UI after the page refactor, or should this stale branch be closed in favor of a fresh implementation tied to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40644?
rationale: The feature is useful and linked to an open request, but this external branch is stale, conflicts with current main, and contains scheduler/status correctness blockers that require choosing whether to invest in rebase/reimplementation versus closing and asking for a fresh PR.

options.title: Ask for fresh rebase/reimplementation
options.body: Keep this PR open only if the author or a sponsor will move it onto `ui/src/pages/cron/*`, preserve the current cron status contract, and fix the scheduler/status/i18n blockers.

options.title: Close this stale branch
options.body: Close this PR and keep the feature discussion on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/40644 if no maintainer wants to sponsor the rebase effort.

options.title: Adopt manually
options.body: A maintainer can extract the useful timeline idea into a new branch, but that should be a manual ownership decision rather than ClawSweeper repair.

recommendation.title: Ask for fresh rebase/reimplementation
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if the author or a sponsor will move it onto `ui/src/pages/cron/*`, preserve the current cron status contract, and fix the scheduler/status/i18n blockers.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current branch and have responded to earlier review threads, so they are the best first routing target for a rebase or fresh implementation request.
